question: Should Skill Workshop add this core review surface and make approval-generated lifecycle calls version-bound while preserving direct proposal-ID calls without a required version?
rationale: The implementation is technically coherent and well-proven, but it adds a user-facing tool and CLI capability and intentionally changes stale approval behavior; repository evidence cannot determine permanent product and compatibility policy.

options.title: Accept the proposed contract
options.body: Land canonical previews plus version-bound approval decisions, retaining optional version guards for direct service, CLI, and tool callers.

options.title: Split preview from binding
options.body: Land the read-only preview surface first and defer approval version binding until its compatibility behavior is separately approved.

options.title: Decline the core surface
options.body: Close the PR and paired issue if maintainers do not want Skill Workshop preview and lifecycle semantics expanded in core.

recommendation.title: Accept the proposed contract
recommendation.body: Land canonical previews plus version-bound approval decisions, retaining optional version guards for direct service, CLI, and tool callers.

likelyOwner.reason: The timeline routed the feature to this account and the decision spans product-facing tools, CLI behavior, and approval UX rather than a mechanical code repair.
